dedupe_keys.name: mobility maps a dataset for open public transport infrastructure and mobility accessibility profiles

description: MOBILITY MAPS: A Dataset for Open Public Transport Infrastructure and Mobility Accessibility Profiles is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Maximilian T. Fischer, Daniel Fürst (University of Konstanz). Introduction This dataset provides an assessment of public transport connectivity across Germany by analyzing both walking distances to the nearest public transport stops as well as the quality of public transport connections for daily usage scenarios with housing-level-granularity on a country-wide scale. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – version 2.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
